newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern starts 2nd Conrail tender.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern starts 2nd Conrail tender.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said it started its second tender offer for all of the Conrail Inc common and series A ESOP convertible junior preferred shares that it does not already own at a price of $115 per share.
Norfolk Southern said the offer will expire March 12 unless it extends the offer.

The company on February 11 started paying for 8,200,000 Conrail shares under its prior tender offer, it added. After completion of the tender, it said it intends to acquire remaining shares in a merger at the same price per share.
Conrail rejected a $10.3-billion takeover offer from Norfolk in favor of a proposed $9.4-billion merger with CSX Corp.
On Monday, Norfolk sought to remove all but three members from Conrail's board of directors and nominated a slate of five directors to serve on it.
It also proposed reducing the board's size to eight from 13 members and have them elected every year.
Conrail charged Norfolk might be breaking U.S. transportation law in its attempts to take control of the board.
